originals.citation: Nachtigall, V., Rummel, N., & Serova, K. (2018). Authentisch ist nicht gleich authentisch – Wie Schülerinnen und Schüler die Authentizität von Lernaktivitäten im Schülerlabor einschätzen. Unterrichtswissenschaft, 46.

quote: The present study, which aims to replicate the findings of a previous study, investigates whether PF has an impact on students' perceived authenticity and their situational interest in an OSL for social sciences.
notes: Publisher PDF not retrievable (login redirect); a web search summary of the paper states it aimed to conceptually replicate the findings of a previous study by Nachtigall et al. (2018). Self-replication; @nachtigall2020 is the productive-failure learning study, not the authenticity study.
